For vision models, content may be an array of parts such as {"type": "text", "text": "..."} and {"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": "https://..."}}.

Model ID served by Inference Providers, for example 'openai/gpt-oss-20b' or 'Qwen/Qwen3-8B'.
